title: CI/CD pipelines: from commit to production
summary: Follow one release through a runner, reproducible builds, artifacts, permissions, AWS deployment and rollback, using the portfolio and Sportslux workflows.

title: Neural networks, backpropagation and Adam
summary: Build a prediction from weighted inputs, send its error backwards, and follow an Adam update into the card bot’s NumPy networks.

title: Self-play and policy iteration
summary: Watch a card policy generate games, label alternative actions with rollouts, refit its networks and face an independent promotion gate.

title: Hidden hands and importance resampling
summary: Turn known cards, missing suits and bids into a weighted collection of possible hands, then use those hands to compare legal plays.

title: Decision trees and random forests
summary: Split match examples into leaves, measure how a split helps, and combine varied trees into a random forest.

title: Gradient boosting: learning the corrections
summary: Build an additive prediction one small tree at a time, starting with squared-error corrections and ending with binary win probabilities.

title: Probability calibration and scoring rules
summary: Distinguish accuracy from honest probabilities, calculate Brier score and log loss, and read a calibration curve.

title: Temporal validation and data leakage
summary: Rebuild one prediction as it could have existed before a match, then keep fitting, tuning and final evaluation on the correct side of time.

title: 3D bin packing and voxel constraints
summary: Place furniture on a voxel grid, reject collisions and unsupported loads, then compare feasible truck fleets.

title: Genetic algorithms for packing orders
summary: Encode a furniture ordering, decode it into a valid load, breed permutation-safe candidates and retain useful improvements.

title: Database concurrency and transaction isolation
summary: Reproduce a double-booking race, separate atomicity from isolation, and protect decisions with locks, constraints and retryable serializable transactions.

title: Multi-tenant authorisation and delegated roles
summary: Resolve a caller, tenant, resource and action, then enforce role permissions and delegation boundaries at the API.

title: Durable background jobs and failure recovery
summary: Keep a calculation alive beyond its HTTP request, claim work safely, recover abandoned jobs and avoid duplicate external effects.

title: Bitboards and efficient state representation
summary: Represent board occupancy as bits, combine sets with bitwise operations and update a position without copying the whole board.

title: Iterative deepening and quiescence search
summary: Keep a completed move ready under a deadline, reuse shallower searches and extend unstable tactical positions beyond the nominal depth.

title: Web Workers, WebAssembly and language boundaries
summary: Move expensive work off the UI thread, account for message costs and follow Python and compiled C through the browser game.

title: Identity resolution and customer memory
summary: Follow an anonymous visitor into cart and order records, distinguish record linkage from verified access, and keep remembered context within its owner’s boundary.

title: Leverage, amortisation and cash-flow modelling
summary: Follow a property, loan and cash account together, distinguish interest from principal, and compare wealth pathways on consistent cash flows.

title: ETL correctness and incremental synchronisation
summary: Move one asset through extraction, transformation and loading, then handle stable keys, checkpoints, deletions and partial failures.

title: Webhooks, HMAC signatures and idempotency
summary: How a backend knows a Shopify webhook is genuine, using a live SHA-256 and HMAC, why retries create duplicates, and how idempotency keys and transactions make each event count exactly once.

title: Retrieval and guardrails for an AI chatbot
summary: How the Curated Wellness chatbot blocks risky requests before the model, picks the right markdown chunks by shared words and boosts, packs them into a fixed budget, and checks the reply with rules in code.

title: Lighting uniformity and differential evolution
summary: How Sportslux works out the lux at every point of a field from a floodlight’s intensity table, scores a design on average light and uniformity, and searches 10^40 designs with differential evolution.

title: Bootstrap resampling of returns
summary: Why the wealth calculator samples real monthly history instead of a bell, how months compound into a year, and why it copies blocks of months, at the same dates for every fund.

title: Monte Carlo simulation and percentile bands
summary: How the wealth calculator turns one guess about returns into 500 random futures, how a seeded generator and the Box–Muller method draw each year’s return, and how percentiles turn the crowd into a band.

title: The unscented Kalman filter
summary: How sigma points carry a belief through a curve without a tangent, with each formula derived, and why that beats the extended filter on wide beliefs, as in the esports predictor.

title: The extended Kalman filter
summary: How the Kalman filter handles a measurement that bends, by working along the tangent at the best guess, with every formula derived from Pythagoras and the slope of the curve.

title: Hash tables and memoisation
summary: How remembering answers turns millions of repeated calls into dozens, how a hash table finds a stored answer instantly, how a chess position becomes a Zobrist key that every piece contributes to and every move edits, and how a transposition table applies it all.

title: Minimax and alpha-beta pruning
summary: How a chess engine picks a move by searching a game tree, and how alpha-beta pruning and move ordering skip most of the tree without changing the answer.

title: Sensor fusion: accelerometer and magnetometer
summary: How a drone works out roll and pitch from gravity, heading from the Earth’s magnetic field, and why it must combine the two, plus calibration and adding a gyroscope.

title: PID control
summary: How a drone uses proportional, integral and derivative terms to reach a target height and hold it, and why latency matters on a Raspberry Pi.

title: The Kalman filter
summary: How a filter combines a prediction with noisy measurements, with every formula derived: why variances add, the precision-weighted average, the Kalman gain and the new uncertainty.

title: O’Brien–Fleming boundaries
summary: How a clinical trial, or an A/B test of a new AI model, can check its results repeatedly and stop early without raising its 5% false positive risk. No statistics background needed.
